criteria.no: No: the item is silent, topical only, partial (some writes bypass the writer), or uses another mechanism.
criteria.unclear: The item's write path cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: Yes: all SQLite writes go to a single writer through an async channel.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` state that all writes to the app's SQLite database are submitted to one writer through an async channel? Judge presence of that design only.

criteria.no: The item has no such design, including when it is silent or states only goals.
criteria.unclear: A stated write path may conflict but cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item has some SQLite writes executed outside one channel-fed writer, or uses several writers.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` propose writing to the app's SQLite database other than by submitting the write to one writer through an async channel? Silence is not conflict; reads and non-SQLite writes are outside `anchor.statement`. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item touches none of these.
criteria.unclear: The item is too vague to tell.
criteria.yes: The item touches a SQLite storage backend, SQLite writes, the SQLite writer, or the template's SQLite store.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` touch the SQLite storage area named in `anchor.scope`? Judge subject overlap only.
